primary_custody.authority_boundary: future custody of the narrowly scoped EFTA broker credential only; no review, admission, release, publication, rights, privacy, or identity authority

precondition.required: Dashboard Team/Members reports MFA enabled; a verified primary TOTP factor exists; a distinct backup TOTP factor is enrolled and separately custodied; a fresh post-enrollment login challenge succeeds
precondition.evidence: timestamped control-plane observation and factor metadata/status only
precondition.note: Supabase platform MFA supplies no recovery codes; organization MFA enforcement is a separate owner decision

transaction_contract: invoke exactly one literal allowlisted EFTA operation
gateway_runtime.browser_boundary: no database password, privileged mutation RPC, service-role key, or broker credential exposed to the browser
gateway_runtime.blocker: Hosted Edge Functions are automatically provisioned with SUPABASE_DB_URL and privileged secret/service-role keys. Project custom secrets are also project-wide rather than function-isolated. Therefore the selected hosted Edge runtime has not demonstrated cryptographic least-authority confinement to the proposed EFTA broker LOGIN.
fields_unfinalized: proof privileged default credentials can be suppressed or isolated

authentication_policy.subject_binding: JWT sub must equal the authenticated auth_user UUID and the active EFTA assignment subject
checks_every_action: signature against current governed JWKS revision
authentication_policy.implementation_gap: The candidate gateway currently exposes an abstract checkRevocation hook. Its SQL authority_context checks MIP sessions/principal_sessions, not the live Supabase auth.sessions row named by JWT session_id. ES256/KID enforcement and the live-session adapter require implementation and requalification.

network_dependency.dependency_contract: Any change from this exact state, inability to inspect it, or loss of pooler reachability fails the EFTA gateway closed pending explicit compatibility review and requalification.

credential_lifecycle.rationale: bounded low-frequency governed workflow has no demonstrated continuous-availability requirement; this avoids a second LOGIN and simultaneous valid credentials
credential_lifecycle.note: Thirty days is a governance choice, not a Supabase/PostgreSQL requirement.
routine: verify MFA and exact governed state
drain and terminate attributable broker sessions
mint fresh secret only inside approved custody boundary
change existing LOGIN password and VALID UNTIL
replace named Edge secret and credential revision
credential_lifecycle.rollback: Never restore a retired password. Failure remains closed and recovery mints a fresh credential/revision.

order: apply NOLOGIN, PASSWORD NULL and expired VALID UNTIL
recover only with fresh owner-authorized revision
emergency_revocation.caveat: Password expiry/NOLOGIN does not prove termination of already authenticated pooler sessions. Database-side current-revision checks and session termination are mandatory.

alternatives.benefit: recovery and continuity without another ordinary human seeing all Edge secrets
alternatives.limit: no online veto or runtime-compromise containment
new_decisions: three share holders or controlled locations
alternatives.recovery_rule: use triggers immediate rotation/revocation and linked receipt

alternatives.limit: new provider/account/recovery principal and provider compromise dependency
requires new KMS/WIF, scoped Supabase management authority, and possibly plan-dependent reviewer controls; not demonstrated

state_change_policy.network_restrictions: mismatch/unreadable/unreachable => fail closed; no alternate privileged path; requalification required
state_change_policy.signing_keys: only exact governed ES256 KID set accepted; HS256/unknown rejected; KID/JWKS revision change suspends until reviewed and requalified
state_change_policy.project_membership: membership/role inventory hash change suspends; potential disclosure triggers incident assessment and credential rotation
state_change_policy.broker_membership: unexpected role, SET/INHERIT/ADMIN option, ownership or direct privilege => reject/suspend and requalify
state_change_policy.live_session: missing/revoked/not checked/unavailable => reject every action; no cached authorization; validate immediately before bounded transaction
state_change_policy.operation_in_flight: revocation can race an already executing transaction; terminate sessions and reconcile every operation near cutoff in receipt

rights_privacy.rule: Public accessibility, government hosting, federal authorship, synthetic qualification evidence, ownership, reviewer selection, and credential custody do not authorize any cell.

custodian principal and nonsecret MFA evidence
session_user and SET LOCAL ROLE results
